owner_creation.analysis: cmd_col: The c_int owns the displayed cursor column; reset/clear initialize it and character output advances it by measured display width.
owner_creation.invariant: Cursor columns describe display state rather than byte storage.
limitations: Source-specific review of coupled legacy editor state; M0-MEM-001 remains open and no new runtime defect is asserted from raw-pointer structure alone.

aliases_escapes.analysis: cmd_col: Width helpers and motion paths read/copy the scalar while cp points into command bytes; the number does not own that cursor or the prompt string.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A display column cannot validate a byte pointer.
